origin_note: All cases synthetic; no real bug-report corpus exists yet.

cases.what: Tab character used for indentation; YAML forbids tabs.
cases.fix_theory: Replace leading tabs with spaces. Purely lexical, no AST needed.

cases.what: Key/value separator missing after `image`.
cases.fix_theory: Ambiguous: cannot tell intended key boundary without guessing.

cases.what: Unterminated double quote in a port mapping.
cases.fix_theory: Could append the closing quote, but the intended end position is a guess.

cases.what: Service block under-indented, breaking the mapping.
cases.fix_theory: Structural. Requires understanding intended hierarchy; comments lost on rewrite.

cases.what: `image` specified twice for one service.
cases.fix_theory: Deleting one is a semantic choice — which one did the user mean?

cases.what: `imge` instead of `image` — a one-character typo.
cases.fix_theory: Edit distance against the known key set gives an unambiguous candidate.

cases.what: `ports` given as a bare number instead of a sequence.
cases.fix_theory: Coerce scalar to a single-element quoted sequence. Type-directed, deterministic.

cases.what: `restart_policy` at service level (it belongs under `deploy`).
cases.fix_theory: Relocating it is a real semantic move; safe only with confirmation.

cases.what: `environment` given as a string instead of map/list.
cases.fix_theory: Splitting `KEY=value` into a one-entry list is mechanical.

cases.what: `depends_on` as a scalar rather than a list.
cases.fix_theory: Wrap in a list. Mechanical.

cases.what: Service mounts `dbdata`, which is never declared top-level.
cases.fix_theory: Append `volumes: {dbdata: }`. The name is known; nothing is guessed.

cases.what: Service joins `backend`, which is never declared.
cases.fix_theory: Append the network declaration. Same shape as the volume case.

cases.what: Service uses secret `db_password`, never declared.
cases.fix_theory: A secret needs a source (file/external) — the app cannot invent one.

cases.what: `${DB_PASSWORD}` interpolated but not set anywhere.
cases.fix_theory: The value is unknowable. A default would silently change behaviour.

cases.what: Two undeclared volumes across two services.
cases.fix_theory: Same as single case but must fix all, not just the first reported.

cases.what: `env_file` points at a file that does not exist.
cases.fix_theory: Creating it changes runtime behaviour; removing it drops config. Neither is safe alone.

cases.what: Build context directory does not exist.
cases.fix_theory: Cannot create someone's Dockerfile. Not fixable by the app.

cases.what: `services` written as a list instead of a mapping.
cases.fix_theory: Convertible in principle, but a full re-serialisation — comments are lost.

cases.what: File has only a version key; no services at all.
cases.fix_theory: Nothing to infer. The user must say what they want to run.

cases.what: Undeclared volume, in a file carrying comments that must survive the fix.
cases.fix_theory: Line-append should preserve comments; a YAML round-trip would destroy them.
